race.comment: HABITUAL (2) only warmed into it late when resuming at Seymour. Is much better placed stretching to the mile second-up and can get the job done this time. KOYUGA RIP (3) finished fourth two runs back then improved last start but found one better over 1600m at Bendigo, beaten a long neck after being prominent at the corner. Ideally placed and is sure to prove tough to beat. JULEP (7) finished sixth at her last appearance over 1500m at Ballarat Synthetic on August 11 but was good the start prior and is a big chance with a repeat of that run. NUMBERSNEVERSEEN (5) was well supported last time out but disappointed in finishing fourth over 1600m at Murtoa, beaten 6 lengths. Warrants another chance in this company.
